notes.title: Ask me (almost) anything!
notes.content:
Come hang out on the Cosmocat Discord and ask us (almost) anything.

🙆‍♂️ Examples of questions you can ask us: 

What are your plans for the game?
What were your inspirations?
How many cats do you have?
What's your favourite beer?


🙅‍♂️ Examples of questions you can't ask:

Do you have a moment to talk about our lord and savior?
What is your stance on ?
What's your credit card number?


Super Rocket Ride is a collaboration between Cosmocat and Unruly Games. It can best be described as a cross between old school lander games and classic platformers of the SNES era: a simple control scheme, lush pixel art, and challenging levels fraught with obstacles and hazards.
